aircraftTool: native SVG authored in packaging script

aircraft.occlusion: Source-derived opaque skyline; includes dome interiors and towers

maskMethod: Original six lighting groups retain source luminance/chroma masks. Aircraft has separate native SVG hull/wake/beacon alpha, independent wake delay data and a source-derived stationary skyline occlusion matte. Hull palette is fixed; only wake colors and beacon emission animate.
blackout: Opaque black base and independent protected light layers; aircraft retains colors and stationary occlusion at environment opacity zero. Its explicit 30-second appearance gate still applies.
uncertainBoundaries: Threshold-derived skyline: very dark edges, antialiasing and fine spire tips require artistic review.
Wheel/body classification cuts may cross a white panel; both are lit but timing direction changes there.
Very fine cyan reflected highlights are intentionally included in road light.
Angular wheel phase wraps at the rear-facing ray; inspect loop seam during zoom.
